groups.label: ш, ж, щ, ч and ц

sounds.how: The front of the tongue presses just behind the upper teeth, a little further back than for т. At the same time the middle of the tongue rises toward the roof of the mouth. A very short hiss as it opens is normal.
sounds.slip: Two sounds, t and then y, or the ch of English "cheese".

sounds.how: The same as ть, with voice: the front of the tongue just behind the upper teeth, the middle of the tongue lifted toward the roof of the mouth.
sounds.slip: The j of English "jam", or d and then y.

sounds.how: The front of the tongue touches just behind the upper teeth and the middle of the tongue rises toward the roof of the mouth. The air goes out through the nose.
sounds.slip: Two sounds, n and then y. It is one sound.

sounds.how: An с with the middle of the tongue lifted toward the roof of the mouth. It sounds thinner and higher than с.
sounds.slip: The sh of English "she". The tongue stays at the teeth.

sounds.how: The front of the tongue touches just behind the upper teeth and the middle of the tongue rises toward the roof of the mouth. It sounds light and thin.
sounds.slip: The dark l at the end of English "full". That is the hard л.

sounds.how: The front of the tongue touches the upper teeth, the middle of the tongue sinks, and the back rises. It sounds dark, like the l at the end of English "full".
sounds.slip: The light l of English "leaf". Before а, о, у and ы the л stays dark.

sounds.how: Say и and pull the whole tongue back, keeping it high and the lips unrounded. The consonant before ы is always hard.
sounds.slip: An и, or the u of English "put" with rounded lips.

sounds.how: Lift the tip of the tongue and pull it back behind the ridge. The middle of the tongue stays low and the lips push forward a little. It sounds darker than English sh and is always hard.
sounds.slip: The soft sh of English "she". That is closer to щ.

sounds.how: The same as ш, with voice: the tip of the tongue lifted and pulled back behind the ridge, the middle of the tongue low, the lips pushed forward a little. It is always hard.
sounds.slip: The softer sound in the middle of English "measure". After ж the letter и sounds like ы: жить.

sounds.how: The front of the tongue rises close to the roof of the mouth, just behind the ridge, and is not pulled back. It is soft and held longer than ш.
sounds.slip: Two sounds, sh and then ch. It is one long, soft sound.

sounds.how: One sound: the front of the tongue closes on the roof of the mouth just behind the ridge and opens into a short щ. It is always soft.
sounds.slip: A hard sound with the tongue pulled back, like ш. It is always soft.

sounds.how: One sound: the front of the tongue closes at the upper teeth, as for т, and opens into с. It is the ts of English "cats". It is always hard.
sounds.slip: A soft sound. After ц the letter и sounds like ы: цирк is said цырк.

sounds.how: Lift the back of the tongue close to the soft back part of the roof of the mouth, as for к, but leave a small gap. The air rubs through it. It is the ch of Scottish "loch".
sounds.slip: A к, where the air stops, or the breath of English h.

sounds.how: Rest the tip of the tongue loosely on the ridge behind the upper teeth and let the air make it tap there quickly.
sounds.slip: The English r, where the tongue touches nothing. Here the tip has to touch the ridge.

sounds.how: Usually a single quick tap of the tip of the tongue on the ridge, with the middle of the tongue lifted toward the roof of the mouth.
sounds.slip: A hard р. Softness changes the word: рад is glad, ряд is a row.

sounds.how: п, т and к are said without the puff of air that p, t and k have at the start of an English word. Hold a hand in front of your mouth: you should feel almost nothing.
sounds.slip: The breathy p, t and k of English "pen", "ten" and "ken".
